title: 第819章 快离开碎石林第818章 死死光了
slug: 全民宗主合成亿万傀儡
content_zh:
荒岛内。
王海看到魂傀汇聚过来的上百王境修为结晶，心中很是高兴。
尤其是还有三颗皇境的。
截止到现在，他已经有了四颗皇境修为结晶，距离二十颗的目标已经越来越近。
一旦凑够二十颗，便可以尝试能否将皇境魂傀提升至仙帝境了。
清点王境修为结晶。
一共113颗！
想要将皇境初期魂傀培养到皇境大圆满，需要120颗。
“只差几颗就能再次培养出一个皇境大圆满魂傀，很快就能完成了。”
王海期待那一刻的到来。
不过看到这荒岛上已经没有敌人，心中不免有些遗憾，要是多几个就好了。
“这一次攻击之后，基本已经暴露了此地拥有皇境的事实，不管万族能不能想到是我在这里主导这一切，此地都不再安全。”王海快速思索眼下的处境。
两个魂傀已经突破完成，还要继续停留在这里吗？
要是继续停留，说不定还能收获一波。
只是，也可能会吸引更强大的敌人，毕竟此地还是靠近万族气运山区域，并不是王境墓地和陨皇山那种万族律法管不到的地带。
“稳妥些，还是要想办法尽快离开。”
很快，他便打定主意。
不过外面肯定有很多种族在盯着此地，想要悄无声息的离开，也并不容易。
需要谋划一番。
然而，正当这时，一枚玉符亮起。

“嗯？是汉王的？”
他有些疑惑，取出接听。
对面传来一句颇为急切的话：“王海，快，速速离开那片碎石林。”
王海大惊。
“汉王，发生什么了？”
“魔界派出了几个皇境大圆满，正在快速赶往你所在的地方，速速离开。”
皇境大圆满？
几个？
王海坐不住了，他立即起身，收起身边的王境魂傀，看向三只皇境魂傀，取出一套隐逸法袍披在皇隼一身上。
“等会儿你全力冲出去，吸引敌人注意。”
凭借皇隼一皇境大圆满的实力，又加上有速度优势，他不会被外面的那些人逮住。
content_en:
In a desert island.
Wang Hai was very happy when he saw the hundreds of king-level cultivation crystals gathered by the soul puppets.
Especially those with three imperial realms.
As of now, he already has four Imperial Realm cultivation crystals, and is getting closer to his goal of twenty.
Once you collect twenty pieces, you can try to see if you can upgrade the Imperial Soul Puppet to the Immortal Emperor Realm.
Count the crystals of King Realm cultivation.
113 pieces in total!
To cultivate a soul puppet from the early stage of the Imperial Realm to the Great Perfection of the Imperial Realm, 120 souls are needed.
"There are only a few left to cultivate an Imperial Realm Dzogchen Soul Puppet again, and it will be completed soon."
Wang Hai is looking forward to that moment.
However, seeing that there are no enemies on this deserted island, I can't help but feel a little regretful. It would be nice if there were more.
"After this attack, the fact that this place has an imperial realm has basically been exposed. No matter whether all races can think that I am leading all this here, this place is no longer safe." Wang Hai quickly thought about the current situation.
The two soul puppets have broken through, do they still want to stay here?
If you continue to stay, you might even get something.
However, it may also attract more powerful enemies. After all, this place is still close to the Ten Thousand Races Qiyun Mountain area, and it is not an area like the King's Realm Cemetery and the Fallen Emperor Mountain that cannot be controlled by the laws of the Ten Thousand Races.
"It's safer to think of a way to leave as soon as possible."
Soon, he made up his mind.
However, there must be many races outside watching this place, and it is not easy to leave quietly.
It takes some planning.
However, at this moment, a jade talisman lit up.
"Huh? Is it from King Han?"
He was a little confused and took out the answer.
A rather urgent word came from the other side: "Wang Hai, quickly, leave that gravel forest quickly."
Wang Hai was shocked.
"King Han, what happened?"
"The Demon Realm has sent several Imperial Realm Perfectionists, who are rushing to where you are. Leave quickly."
Imperial Dzogchen?
several?
Wang Hai couldn't sit still anymore. He immediately stood up, put away the king-level soul puppets beside him, looked at the three emperor-level soul puppets, took out a set of hermit robes and put them on Huang Falconyi.
"Later, you rush out with all your strength to attract the enemy's attention."
With the strength of the Emperor Falcon and the speed advantage, he will not be caught by those outside.
